The '''Anturus system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA" /> and [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]<ref name="Western Reaches" /> regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Anturus]].<ref name="TEA" />
